lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and holders of 5% or more of its shares agreed not to sell for 180 days after the offering closes, with some exceptions.

what: It supplies transformers, switchgear and other electrical equipment to customers across Malaysia, and helps with testing and setup.
risks: It has grown quickly and has limited experience at its current size, so poor management of growth could hurt its results.
It may not respond well to changes in technology or in how its industry does business, which could harm the company.
It relies on many outside providers, and losing a major one could hurt its operations.
If it cannot build a strong brand, it may not keep or win customers.
If its product and service quality slips, its reputation and results could suffer.
